- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:112,117-137,160-181 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Two parallel bounding mechanisms for the sandbox `agents.md` copy coexist, in different units, with different caps and different truncation markers. Only the byte-based one is live.
  WHY: A maintainer who tunes the dead constant changes nothing on the live path. Minimax also notes the naming makes the new helper look like it supersedes the old one.
- changelog.d/9776-sandbox-agents-md-cap.md:2 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The changelog says the sandbox copy is cut to 262,144 characters and that failing review-blocked assertions show the stdout tail. The live cap is 524,288 bytes, and many review-blocked asserts are still bare.
  WHY: Operators get the wrong cap value and an overstated diagnostic coverage. Severity differs (NIT vs MAJOR), so the highest is used.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:12276-12447 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Many review-blocked tests (lines 12418, 12427, 12435, 12443, 12276, 12287, 12298, 12310, 12320, 12329, 12338, 12347, 12361, 12378, 12397, 12405) still use bare `assert "..." in result["stdout"]`.
  WHY: A future failure will not show the poller stdout tail, so the diagnostic goal is only partly met.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:117-137 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: When no `\n` precedes the limit, `_copy_sandbox_file_bounded` writes only the truncation marker and no head.
  WHY: A pathological `agents.md` would produce a near-empty sandbox document.
